授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
<Work Experiences>
The instructor is an active researcher in thermal engineering with extensive experiences of phase-change heat transfer, thermofluids and heat exchangers. The instructor works on several projects in collaboration with industry.
<How these experiences can be applied to the lecture>
The lecture will provide fundamental knowledge of heat transfer with emphasis on the links to practical industrial systems and latest research activities.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Controlling the rate of heat transfer and temperature is critically important for the design and operation of many devices, equipment and systems. This is achieved by predicting the rate of heat transfer based on the understanding of the mechanism of heat transfer. This introductory course is designed to acquire the principle of heat conduction, the most primitive mechanism of heat transfer, together with the idea of energy conservation to solve simple problems that are governed only by heat conduction.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Heat conduction; Fourier's law; Thermal energy conservation; Heat equation
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: This course is offered for the third year International Course Students in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering as a compulsory subject.
